newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to launch inflation-indexed bonds - Minister.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to launch inflation-indexed bonds - Minister.

text.p: Turkish State Minister Ufuk Soylemez said on Monday the Treasury might launch a long-awaited inflation-indexed bond issue on Tuesday.
"If the Treasury completes its preparations, it will begin a new borrowing method from tomorrow (Tuesday)," Soylemez told reporters at the opening of a state bank branch.

"In addition to current domestic and foreign borrowing methods, this will be a new issue having a return calculated by multiplying the consumer price index by a risk premium. The risk premium will be obtained via an auction," Soylemez added.
Soylemez said the bonds would have a two-year maturity and accrued interest would be paid every three months.
The Treasury has not yet annouced an auction but began sending detailed brochures on the calculation of inflation- times-risk-premium bonds to banks and brokerage houses.
